sources.title: Immigration Regulations, 2009 (current Parliament-hosted file)
sources.publisher: Nitijela (Parliament), Republic of the Marshall Islands
sources.officialityEvidence: Nitijela hosts this operative Immigration Regulations file. Section 6 conditions the visitor visa on a country having diplomatic ties with the Republic.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visitor Visas, to citizens of Countries which the Republic has diplomatic ties with.

sources.title: Embassy of the Republic of the Marshall Islands: consular visa information
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Republic of the Marshall Islands, Washington, D.C.
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Embassy consular page sets out A (waiver), B (diplomatic-relations arrival route), and C (visa before travel). Its link to a claimed current country summary returned HTTP 404, so that unavailable list is not used to classify any nationality.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens from ALL OTHER countries not listed in A or B above must apply for visa PRIOR TO traveling to the Republic.
